correctness.rationale: For all n≥5, N=binom(n,2), the KG(n,2) loopless binary adjacency is exactly A=I+BᵀB+J over F2, with B the vertex-edge incidence matrix of K_n. The identities T²=(n mod 2)T, TJ=JT=0 and J²=(N mod 2)J imply A²=I for n≡0; A³=A for n≡1,2; and A²=A for n≡3 (mod4). Rank T equals n−2 for even n and n−1 for odd n, giving exact rank A and rank(A−I), so all states are either periodic or enter a period≤2 orbit after one update. Each periodic point has equally sized preimage fiber, yielding the table of fixed states, 2-cycle orbits and basin sizes. The flip map (A+I) on im A has image T+J, J, T, 0 by residue, respectively. im T is the even-cut space for even n and the all-ones mask lies outside it. Directly recomputed the adjacency matrices and F2 ranks for n=5..11 and flip-space dimensions, corroborating the symbolic all-n proof. Four residue cases and the sharp first-entry time are addressed, not spatial automorphism-orbit classes.
